guides.favoredWhen: Very easy. Q through the wave, hold W, and R her commits.

keyTips.text: She hides behind minions: your Q extends through them.
She rushes Mercs: your root still decides every fight.
Your W is her death: she commits only when you misuse it.

tips.text: Spam Q from range: your poke beats her poke.
She concedes the lane: take every CS she gives.
After your 6 she cannot force: hold R for her commits.
Hold W: a misused root is her only engage.
Roots plus patience: the Akali who never touches you never kills you.

guides.favoredWhen: You are rarely killable. R plus jungle beats his all-ins, so take TP and win the map.

keyTips.text: He finds you rarely killable: your R plus jungle and support camping beats his all-ins.
Your Q extends through the wave: punish him when he lines up with it.
Good TP matchup for you: match his map pressure, never force the duel.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: When his W is down, E onto him: the window is yours.
He plays for TP, not kills: answer his shoves and hold your R.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
When he shoves and roams, match: your R answers his plays.
The 1v1 decides nothing: TP plays and roams decide it.
